end.summary:
Practised shared responsibility for a clean, green, safe school and everyday actions such as picking up wrappers.
Sorted examples into wet waste (vegetable peels, leftover dal) and dry waste (newspaper, plastic toy).
Discussed green bins for compostable waste and blue bins for recyclable dry waste.
The belief that plastic rots into soil in a compost pit was repeated and was not corrected by the end of the lesson.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Anika practised keeping school spaces clean and sorting wet and dry waste. They gave examples such as potato peels and leftover dal for the green bin, and newspaper and a broken plastic toy for the blue bin. The mix-up that plastic turns into soil in a compost pit remained at the end, so please revisit: only suitable wet waste goes into compost; plastic does not rot. At home, sort a few household items together and ask Anika to explain why each belongs in the green or blue bin.
